name: useToggle
description: Boolean state with toggle and explicit set.

parameters.name: initialValue
parameters.description: The value the toggle starts from.

returns.name: [0] value
returns.description: The current boolean state.

returns.name: [1] toggle
returns.description: Flips the value.

returns.name: [2] setValue
returns.description: Sets the value explicitly.

name: useForm
description: Controlled form state with one change handler.
signature: useForm<T>(initialState: T): { values: T; handleChange: (e: ChangeEvent) => void; resetForm: () => void }

parameters.name: initialState
parameters.description: Initial field values. Keys must match the name attribute of each input.

returns.name: values
returns.description: The current form values.

returns.name: handleChange
returns.description: One change handler for every named input, textarea and select.

returns.name: resetForm
returns.description: Restores initialState.

name: useLocalStorage
description: State persisted to localStorage
signature: useLocalStorage<T>(key: string, initialValue: T): { value: T; setStoredValue: (value: T | ((val: T) => T)) => void }

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The localStorage key to read and write.

parameters.name: initialValue
parameters.description: Value used before hydration and when the key is empty. Prefer a stable reference — the sync effect depends on it.

returns.name: value
returns.description: The stored value. Server-rendered as initialValue, then synced from localStorage after mount.

returns.name: setStoredValue
returns.description: Persists to localStorage and updates state; accepts a value or an updater function.

name: useLocalStorageWithExpiry
description: Persisted state with a TTL.
signature: useLocalStorageWithExpiry<T>(key: string, initialValue: T, expiryMs: number): { value: T | null; setStoredValue: (value: T) => void }

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The localStorage key to read and write.

parameters.name: initialValue
parameters.description: Value used before hydration and when nothing is stored under the key.

parameters.name: expiryMs
parameters.description: Time-to-live in milliseconds. Every write stores the value with a fresh expiry timestamp.

returns.name: value
returns.description: The stored value, or null once the item has expired. Expiry is checked when the hook reads — on mount or key change — at which point the item is removed.

returns.name: setStoredValue
returns.description: Persists the value to localStorage with a new expiry of now + expiryMs.

name: useSessionStorage
description: useState backed by sessionStorage, synced across tabs.
signature: useSessionStorage<T>(key: string, initialValue: T | (() => T), options?: UseSessionStorageOptions<T>): [T, (value: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void, () => void]

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The sessionStorage key to read and write.

parameters.name: initialValue
parameters.description: Value used before hydration and when the key is empty. Pass a function to compute it lazily.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Optional custom serializer/deserializer and hydration flag.

returns.name: [0] value
returns.description: The stored value. Server-rendered as initialValue, then hydrated from sessionStorage after mount.

returns.name: [1] setValue
returns.description: Persists to sessionStorage and updates state; accepts a value or an updater. Syncs every hook using the key in this tab.

returns.name: [2] removeValue
returns.description: Removes the key from sessionStorage and resets state to initialValue.

typeAliases.name: UseSessionStorageOptions<T>
typeAliases.description: Custom (de)serialization and hydration behaviour.

rows.name: serializer
rows.description: Turn the value into the string stored under the key. Defaults to JSON.stringify.

rows.name: deserializer
rows.description: Parse the stored string back into a value. Defaults to JSON.parse.

rows.name: initializeWithValue
rows.description: Read sessionStorage synchronously on mount. Set false to defer to after hydration and avoid SSR mismatches.

name: useReadLocalStorage
description: Read a localStorage key without writing it, reactively.
signature: useReadLocalStorage<T>(key: string, options?: UseReadLocalStorageOptions<T>): T | null

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The localStorage key to observe.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Optional custom deserializer and hydration flag.

returns.name: value
returns.description: The parsed value, or null when the key is absent. Re-renders when the key changes in another tab (storage event) or via a local-storage event dispatched in this tab.

typeAliases.name: UseReadLocalStorageOptions<T>
typeAliases.description: Custom deserialization and hydration behaviour.

rows.name: deserializer
rows.description: Parse the stored string into a value. Defaults to JSON.parse, falling back to the raw string.

rows.name: initializeWithValue
rows.description: Read localStorage synchronously on mount. Set false to defer to after hydration and avoid SSR mismatches.

name: useDarkMode
description: Dark-mode boolean with toggle.

returns.name: isDarkMode
returns.description: Current mode. Initialized from localStorage("theme") on the client; false during SSR.

returns.name: toggleDarkMode
returns.description: Flips the mode. An effect persists it to localStorage("theme") and toggles a "dark" class on <body>.

name: useTernaryDarkMode
description: Three-state dark mode — system, dark or light — persisted.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Optional starting mode and localStorage key.

returns.description: The resolved isDarkMode boolean, the stored ternary preference, and its setters.

typeAliases.name: TernaryDarkMode
typeAliases.description: The three possible preferences.

rows.name: value
rows.description: "system" resolves against the OS; "dark"/"light" force a mode.

typeAliases.name: UseTernaryDarkModeOptions
typeAliases.description: Optional starting mode and persistence key.

rows.name: defaultValue
rows.description: The mode before anything is stored: "system", "dark" or "light".

rows.name: localStorageKey
rows.description: The localStorage key the choice is persisted under.

typeAliases.name: UseTernaryDarkModeReturn
typeAliases.description: The resolved mode plus setters.

rows.name: isDarkMode
rows.description: True when the mode is "dark", or "system" while the OS prefers dark.

rows.name: ternaryDarkMode
rows.description: The stored preference: "system" | "dark" | "light".

rows.name: setTernaryDarkMode
rows.description: Set the preference directly; accepts a value or an updater.

rows.name: toggleTernaryDarkMode
rows.description: Cycle the preference: light → system → dark → light.

name: useBoolean
description: Boolean state with setTrue, setFalse, toggle and set.
signature: useBoolean(defaultValue?: boolean): { value: boolean; setValue: (value: boolean) => void; setTrue: () => void; setFalse: () => void; toggle: () => void }

parameters.name: defaultValue
parameters.description: The value the boolean starts from.

returns.name: value
returns.description: The current boolean value.

returns.name: setValue
returns.description: Sets the value directly.

returns.name: setTrue
returns.description: Sets the value to true.

returns.name: setFalse
returns.description: Sets the value to false.

returns.name: toggle
returns.description: Flips the value.

name: useCounter
description: Numeric counter with increment, decrement and reset.
signature: useCounter(initialValue?: number): { count: number; increment: () => void; decrement: () => void; reset: () => void; setCount: Dispatch<SetStateAction<number>> }

parameters.name: initialValue
parameters.description: The count the hook starts from; reset returns here.

returns.name: count
returns.description: The current count.

returns.name: increment
returns.description: Adds one to the count.

returns.name: decrement
returns.description: Subtracts one from the count.

returns.name: reset
returns.description: Restores the count to initialValue.

returns.name: setCount
returns.description: Sets the count directly; accepts a value or an updater function.

name: useStep
description: 1-indexed step counter for wizards and steppers.

parameters.name: maxStep
parameters.description: The highest reachable step (inclusive). Steps run from 1 to maxStep.

returns.name: [0] step
returns.description: The current step, 1-indexed.

returns.name: [1] actions
returns.description: Controls for moving between steps — see below.

typeAliases.name: UseStepActions
typeAliases.description: The second tuple element — the stepper controls.

rows.name: goToNextStep
rows.description: Advances to the next step; a no-op at maxStep.

rows.name: goToPrevStep
rows.description: Goes back one step; a no-op at step 1.

rows.name: reset
rows.description: Resets back to step 1.

rows.name: canGoToNextStep
rows.description: Whether a next step is available.

rows.name: canGoToPrevStep
rows.description: Whether a previous step is available.

rows.name: setStep
rows.description: Sets the step directly (1-indexed); throws if outside the 1..maxStep range.

name: useCountdown
description: Self-stopping countdown or count-up timer.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Configures the timer — start value, tick interval, direction and stop value. See below.

returns.name: [0] count
returns.description: The current count. Ticks by ±1 every intervalMs while running.

returns.name: [1] actions
returns.description: Start, pause and reset controls — see below.

typeAliases.name: UseCountdownOptions
typeAliases.description: The single options argument.

rows.name: countStart
rows.description: The value the countdown starts from.

rows.name: intervalMs
rows.description: Milliseconds between ticks. Defaults to 1000.

rows.name: isIncrement
rows.description: Count up instead of down. Defaults to false.

rows.name: countStop
rows.description: The value at which the timer stops itself. Defaults to 0.

typeAliases.name: UseCountdownActions
typeAliases.description: The second tuple element — the timer controls.

rows.name: startCountdown
rows.description: Starts (or resumes) the timer.

rows.name: stopCountdown
rows.description: Pauses the timer without resetting the count.

rows.name: resetCountdown
rows.description: Stops the timer and resets the count to countStart.

name: useMap
description: Manage a Map as immutable React state.
signature: useMap<K, V>(initialState?: MapOrEntries<K, V>): [ReadOnlyMap<K, V>, UseMapActions<K, V>]

parameters.name: initialState
parameters.description: Initial entries as a Map or an array of [key, value] pairs.

returns.name: [0] map
returns.description: A read-only view of the map — the mutating set/clear/delete methods are omitted; use the actions instead. get, has, size and iteration remain.

returns.name: [1] actions
returns.description: Stable helpers that replace the map with a fresh copy so React re-renders — see below.

typeAliases.name: UseMapActions
typeAliases.description: The second tuple element — the map mutation helpers.

rows.name: set
rows.description: Adds or updates one entry.

rows.name: setAll
rows.description: Replaces every entry with the given Map or [key, value] pairs.

rows.name: remove
rows.description: Deletes the entry for the given key.

rows.name: reset
rows.description: Empties the map.

name: useDebounce
description: Debounces a changing value.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to debounce — any type works.

parameters.name: delay
parameters.description: Milliseconds the value must stay unchanged before the debounced value updates.

returns.name: debouncedValue
returns.description: Trails the input value, updating only after delay ms without a change.

name: useDebounceValue
description: State whose debounced copy updates after a pause.
signature: useDebounceValue<T>(initialValue: T | (() => T), delayMs?: number, options?: DebounceOptions & { equalityFn?: (left: T, right: T) => boolean }): [T, DebouncedState<[T | ((prev: T) => T)], void>]

parameters.name: initialValue
parameters.description: The starting value, or a factory evaluated once on mount — the same lazy-initializer contract as useState.

parameters.name: delayMs
parameters.description: Milliseconds of inactivity before the debounced value catches up to the latest set value.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: DebounceOptions plus an optional equalityFn (left, right) => boolean — when it reports the values equal, the debounced update is skipped. See the tables below.

returns.name: [0] debouncedValue
returns.description: The value that trails the setter, updating only after delayMs of quiet.

returns.name: [1] setValue
returns.description: A debounced setter accepting a value or updater; it also carries cancel, flush and isPending (see DebouncedState).

typeAliases.name: DebounceOptions
typeAliases.description: Controls how the debounced invocation is scheduled.

rows.name: leading
rows.description: Invoke on the leading edge — run once immediately on the first call of a burst.

rows.name: trailing
rows.description: Invoke on the trailing edge — run after the burst settles.

rows.name: maxWait
rows.description: The maximum time the callback may be delayed before it is forced to run, even during a continuous burst.

typeAliases.name: DebouncedState<Args, R>
typeAliases.description: The debounced function, plus manual control methods.

rows.name: (...args)
rows.description: Calling it schedules an invocation and returns the last computed result — undefined before the first run.

rows.name: cancel
rows.description: Cancels any pending trailing invocation.

rows.name: flush
rows.description: Immediately runs any pending invocation and returns its result.

rows.name: isPending
rows.description: Whether a trailing invocation is currently scheduled.

name: useDebounceCallback
description: Debounces a callback, with cancel, flush and isPending.
signature: useDebounceCallback<Args, R>(fn: (...args: Args) => R, delayMs?: number, options?: DebounceOptions): DebouncedState<Args, R>

parameters.name: fn
parameters.description: The function to debounce. The returned function keeps a stable identity across renders but always invokes the latest fn.

parameters.name: delayMs
parameters.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last call before fn runs.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Leading/trailing edge and maxWait behaviour. See the table below.

returns.name: debounced
returns.description: A debounced version of fn with a stable identity, carrying cancel, flush and isPending. Any pending call is cancelled on unmount.

typeAliases.name: DebounceOptions
typeAliases.description: Controls how the debounced invocation is scheduled.

rows.name: leading
rows.description: Invoke on the leading edge — run once immediately on the first call of a burst.

rows.name: trailing
rows.description: Invoke on the trailing edge — run after the burst settles.

rows.name: maxWait
rows.description: The maximum time the callback may be delayed before it is forced to run, even during a continuous burst.

typeAliases.name: DebouncedState<Args, R>
typeAliases.description: The debounced function, plus manual control methods.

rows.name: (...args)
rows.description: Calling it schedules an invocation and returns the last computed result — undefined before the first run.

rows.name: cancel
rows.description: Cancels any pending trailing invocation.

rows.name: flush
rows.description: Immediately runs any pending invocation and returns its result.

rows.name: isPending
rows.description: Whether a trailing invocation is currently scheduled.

name: useInterval
description: Runs a callback on a fixed interval; pause by passing null.
signature: useInterval(callback: () => void, delay: number | null): void

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Runs on every tick. Always fires the latest callback — the hook keeps a ref, so you never re-arm the timer just to close over fresh state.

parameters.name: delay
parameters.description: Milliseconds between ticks. Pass null to pause — the interval is cleared, so nothing runs until you set a number again.

name: useTimeout
description: Runs a callback once after a delay; cancel by passing null.
signature: useTimeout(callback: () => void, delay: number | null): void

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Runs once after the delay elapses. The hook keeps a ref to the latest callback, so it always fires with fresh state.

parameters.name: delay
parameters.description: Milliseconds to wait before firing. Pass null to disable — a change to null before the delay elapses cancels the pending timeout.

name: useIsomorphicLayoutEffect
description: useLayoutEffect on the client, useEffect on the server.

parameters.name: effect
parameters.description: The effect to run — same contract as React's useLayoutEffect, including an optional cleanup return.

parameters.name: deps
parameters.description: Dependency array controlling when the effect re-runs. Omit to run after every render.

name: useEventCallback
description: A stable callback that always calls the latest closure.
signature: useEventCallback<Args extends unknown[], R>(fn: (...args: Args) => R): (...args: Args) => R

parameters.name: fn
parameters.description: The function to keep current behind a stable reference. Calling during render throws — it is meant for event handlers and effects.

returns.name: callback
returns.description: A memoized callback with an unchanging identity that always forwards to the latest fn.

name: useUnmount
description: Runs a cleanup function once, when the component unmounts.

parameters.name: fn
parameters.description: Called exactly once when the component unmounts. The latest closure is captured in a ref, so it always sees fresh values.

name: useIsClient
description: Reports false on the server and true after hydration.

returns.name: isClient
returns.description: false during server rendering and the first hydration pass, then true once mounted in the browser. Gate browser-only UI on it to keep both renders identical.

name: useIsMounted
description: A stable getter for whether the component is still mounted.

returns.name: isMounted
returns.description: A stable getter that returns true while mounted and false after unmount. Call it inside async callbacks before setting state; its identity never changes, so it is safe to omit from dependency arrays.

name: useDocumentTitle
description: Keeps document.title in sync with a value, SSR-safe.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: The document title to apply. Written to document.title in a layout effect on the client and skipped during server rendering.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Behaviour options (see below).

typeAliases.name: UseDocumentTitleOptions
typeAliases.description: Options controlling unmount behaviour.

rows.name: preserveTitleOnUnmount
rows.description: When false, the title captured on mount is restored when the component unmounts. Defaults to true, which leaves the title in place.

name: useEventListener
description: Subscribe to a window, document or element event with cleanup.
signature: useEventListener<K>(eventName: K, handler: (event: Event) => void, element?: RefObject<T>, options?: boolean | AddEventListenerOptions): void

parameters.name: eventName
parameters.description: The event to listen for, typed against the target's event map (window, document, media query, or element).

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: Called with the typed event on every dispatch. Held in a ref, so updating it never detaches and re-attaches the listener.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: Optional ref to the target. Defaults to window when omitted.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Standard addEventListener options (capture, passive, once).

name: useClickOutside
description: Runs a callback on outside click.
signature: useClickOutside<T extends HTMLElement>(ref: RefObject<T>, callback: () => void): void

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Ref attached to the element that counts as inside — clicks within it (or its children) never fire the callback.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Called on every mousedown outside the ref'd element — even while your UI is closed, so guard inside the callback if needed.

name: useMousePosition
description: Cursor coordinates within an element.
signature: useMousePosition<T extends HTMLElement>(ref: RefObject<T>): { x: number | null; y: number | null }

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Ref attached to the element the coordinates are measured against.

returns.name: x
returns.description: Cursor X relative to the element's left edge; null until the first mousemove. Updates on every window mousemove, so it can go negative or exceed the element's width.

returns.name: y
returns.description: Cursor Y relative to the element's top edge; null until the first mousemove.

name: useInfiniteScroll
description: Triggers loading near the scroll end.

parameters.name: fetchMoreData
parameters.description: Called when the window scroll comes within 500px of the document bottom. Must return a promise — the hook stays in the fetching state until it resolves.

returns.name: isFetching
returns.description: True while a triggered fetchMoreData promise is pending; blocks re-triggering until it resolves.

name: useExpandableText
description: Collapse long text by a character and/or line budget with a show-more toggle.
signature: useExpandableText<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLElement>(text: string, options?: UseExpandableTextOptions): UseExpandableTextResult<T>

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The full text to (maybe) collapse.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Character and/or line budgets and display options. Whichever limit clips first wins.

returns.name: text
returns.description: The text to render — character-capped when collapsed and maxChars is set, otherwise the full text.

returns.name: isExpanded
returns.description: Whether the full text is currently shown.

returns.name: isTruncated
returns.description: True when either limit actually clips the text — use it to hide the toggle when the text fits.

returns.name: toggle
returns.description: Flip between expanded and collapsed.

returns.name: expand
returns.description: Show the full text.

returns.name: collapse
returns.description: Collapse back to the limit.

returns.name: ref
returns.description: Attach to the text element. Required for the maxLines clamp and its overflow measurement.

returns.name: clampStyle
returns.description: Spread onto the text element; applies the CSS line-clamp while collapsed and maxLines is set.

typeAliases.name: UseExpandableTextOptions
typeAliases.description: Character and line budgets — provide either, or both.

rows.name: maxChars
rows.description: Max characters shown while collapsed. Pure string logic (SSR-safe), trimmed to a word boundary.

rows.name: maxLines
rows.description: Max lines shown while collapsed. Applied as a CSS line-clamp and measured in the DOM, so it re-clips on resize.

rows.name: ellipsis
rows.description: Appended to character-truncated text.

rows.name: defaultExpanded
rows.description: Whether the text starts expanded.

name: useHover
description: Tracks whether the pointer is hovering an element.
signature: useHover<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLElement>(elementRef: RefObject<T>): boolean

parameters.name: elementRef
parameters.description: Ref to the element whose hover state to track. mouseenter/mouseleave are attached to it and cleaned up automatically.

returns.name: isHovered
returns.description: True while the pointer is over the element, false otherwise. Starts false on the server and until the first mouseenter.

name: useIntersectionObserver
description: Observe an element's viewport intersection reactively.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Observer thresholds, root, and behaviour flags. All optional.

returns.name: ref
returns.description: Ref callback to attach to the element you want to observe.

returns.name: isIntersecting
returns.description: Whether the observed element currently intersects the root.

returns.name: entry
returns.description: The most recent observer entry (intersectionRatio, boundingClientRect…), or null before the first report.

typeAliases.name: UseIntersectionObserverOptions
typeAliases.description: Configures the underlying IntersectionObserver.

rows.name: threshold
rows.description: One or more visibility ratios at which to fire.

rows.name: root
rows.description: The element used as the viewport. Defaults to the browser viewport.

rows.name: rootMargin
rows.description: Margin around the root, in CSS-margin syntax — grows or shrinks the trigger area.

rows.name: freezeOnceVisible
rows.description: Once the target is visible, stop observing and keep the visible state.

rows.name: initialIsIntersecting
rows.description: isIntersecting value used before the observer first reports.

rows.name: onChange
rows.description: Called with the latest entry whenever intersection changes.

typeAliases.name: UseIntersectionObserverReturn
typeAliases.description: The ref callback plus the current intersection state.

rows.name: ref
rows.description: Attach to the element you want to observe.

rows.name: isIntersecting
rows.description: Whether the target currently intersects the root.

rows.name: entry
rows.description: The most recent observer entry, or null before the first report.

name: useResizeObserver
description: Measure an element's size reactively via ResizeObserver.
signature: useResizeObserver<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLElement>(ref: RefObject<T>, options?: UseResizeObserverOptions): ResizeObserverSize

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Ref to the element to measure. The observer attaches to ref.current.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Which box to measure and an optional resize callback.

returns.name: width
returns.description: The element's measured width; undefined until the first observed layout.

returns.name: height
returns.description: The element's measured height; undefined until the first observed layout.

typeAliases.name: UseResizeObserverOptions
typeAliases.description: Configures the underlying ResizeObserver.

rows.name: box
rows.description: Which box model to measure: content-box, border-box or device-pixel-content-box.

rows.name: onResize
rows.description: Called with the freshly measured size on every resize.

typeAliases.name: ResizeObserverSize
typeAliases.description: The size the hook returns; both values are undefined until the first measurement.

rows.name: width
rows.description: Measured width in pixels.

rows.name: height
rows.description: Measured height in pixels.

name: useScrollLock
description: Lock and restore scrolling on the body or an element.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Auto-lock behaviour, the lock target, and scrollbar compensation.

returns.name: isLocked
returns.description: Whether the target's scroll is currently locked.

returns.name: lock
returns.description: Lock the target's scroll (sets overflow: hidden, optionally padding-compensated).

returns.name: unlock
returns.description: Restore the target's original scroll behaviour.

typeAliases.name: UseScrollLockOptions
typeAliases.description: Controls what is locked and when.

rows.name: autoLock

rows.name: lockTarget

rows.name: widthReflow
rows.description: Compensate for the removed scrollbar with padding so the layout does not shift.

typeAliases.name: UseScrollLockReturn
typeAliases.description: The current lock state plus manual controls.

rows.name: isLocked
rows.description: Whether the target's scroll is currently locked.

rows.name: lock
rows.description: Lock the target's scroll.

rows.name: unlock
rows.description: Restore the target's original scroll behaviour.

name: useClickAnyWhere
description: Run a handler on every click anywhere in the document.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: Called with the MouseEvent on every document-wide click. The latest handler is always used — no stale closure.

name: useMediaQuery
description: Tracks whether a CSS media query currently matches.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: A CSS media query string, e.g. "(min-width: 768px)" or "(prefers-color-scheme: dark)".

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: SSR default and hydration behaviour. Optional.

returns.name: matches
returns.description: Whether the query currently matches. Re-renders on every matchMedia change event, and starts from defaultValue on the server.

typeAliases.name: UseMediaQueryOptions
typeAliases.description: Configures the server value and mount behaviour.

rows.name: defaultValue
rows.description: Value returned on the server and before hydration.

rows.name: initializeWithValue
rows.description: Read the real match synchronously on mount. Set false to always start from defaultValue and avoid a hydration mismatch.

name: useScreen
description: Tracks window.screen, refreshing it on every resize.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Hydration behaviour. Optional.

returns.name: screen
returns.description: The current window.screen (width, height, availWidth, colorDepth, orientation…), refreshed on every resize. null on the server and until hydration.

typeAliases.name: UseScreenOptions
typeAliases.description: Configures mount behaviour.

rows.name: initializeWithValue
rows.description: Read the real screen synchronously on mount. Set false to start as null and populate after hydration.

name: useWindowSize
description: Tracks the viewport's { width, height }, updated on resize.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Hydration behaviour. Optional.

returns.name: width
returns.description: The viewport's inner width in pixels. 0 on the server and until hydration.

returns.name: height
returns.description: The viewport's inner height in pixels. 0 on the server and until hydration.

typeAliases.name: WindowSize
typeAliases.description: The viewport size reported by useWindowSize.

rows.name: width
rows.description: The viewport's inner width in pixels.

rows.name: height
rows.description: The viewport's inner height in pixels.

typeAliases.name: UseWindowSizeOptions
typeAliases.description: Configures mount behaviour.

rows.name: initializeWithValue
rows.description: Read the real size synchronously on mount. Set false to start at 0 and populate after hydration.

name: useCopyToClipboard
description: Copy text to the clipboard, tracking the last copied value.

returns.name: [0] copiedText
returns.description: The last successfully-copied string, or null before any copy or after a failed one.

returns.name: [1] copy
returns.description: Writes text to the clipboard. Resolves true on success, false when the API is unavailable or the write is rejected.

rows.name: value
rows.description: The tracked copied text, or null.

rows.name: value

name: useScript

name: useFetch
description: Declarative fetch with loading and error status.
signature: useFetch<T>(url: string): { data: T | null; loading: boolean; error: Error | null }

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The endpoint to GET. The request starts on mount and re-runs whenever the url changes.

returns.name: data
returns.description: The parsed JSON body; null until the first request succeeds. Kept from the previous url while a refetch is in flight.

returns.name: error
returns.description: Set on network failure or a non-ok response ("HTTP error! status: 404"). Never cleared by later requests — remount the component (e.g. key={url}) for fresh state.

returns.name: loading
returns.description: True until the first request settles. Not reset to true when the url changes — remount for a per-request loading flag.

rows.name: message

name: useDraggable
description: Drag an element with pointer or keyboard: bounds, grid, axis lock, smoothing, and jump-to-click.
signature: useDraggable<T extends HTMLElement, C extends HTMLElement>(options?: UseDraggableOptions): UseDraggableReturn<T, C>

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Every option is optional. See the UseDraggableOptions table below.

returns.name: ref
returns.description: Callback ref for the draggable element. The hook moves it with transform: translate3d(), so layout is untouched.

returns.name: containerRef
returns.description: Callback ref for the canvas that jumpOnClick listens on.

returns.name: position
returns.description: The current position in unit. In controlled mode it is the position prop.

returns.name: isDragging
returns.description: true while a pointer drag is in progress.

returns.name: moveTo
returns.description: Move programmatically. Bounds and grid still apply; in controlled mode it calls onChange instead.

returns.name: reset
returns.description: Move back to initialPosition.

typeAliases.name: UseDraggableOptions
typeAliases.description: Pass position + onChange for controlled use, or initialPosition for uncontrolled.

rows.name: unit
rows.description: px: translate offset from the layout spot. ratio: where the anchor point sits in the bounds box, 0..1 per axis, so it survives resizes. Needs element bounds.

rows.name: position
rows.description: Controlled position. Input calls onChange; the element moves only when this prop changes.

rows.name: initialPosition
rows.description: Uncontrolled starting position.

rows.name: onChange
rows.description: Called when a drag, jump, arrow key or moveTo produces a new position. Not called for prop changes or resize re-clamps.

rows.name: bounds
rows.description: Keep the element inside a box. Element bounds are live: re-measured on every gesture and on resize.

rows.name: axis
rows.description: Restrict movement to one axis.

rows.name: grid
rows.description: Snap the translate offset to a px grid.

rows.name: jumpOnClick
rows.description: Pressing an empty spot of the container jumps the element there; holding keeps dragging.

rows.name: anchor
rows.description: The element point that lands on the pointer when jumping, and that a ratio position describes.

rows.name: transition
rows.description: Jump animation length in ms; 0 snaps instantly.

rows.name: smoothing
rows.description: How softly the element trails the pointer, from 0 (glued) to just under 1 (floaty). Reduced motion turns it off.

rows.name: keyboardStep
rows.description: Arrow-key step in px when the element is focused; the grid step wins when grid is set.

rows.name: disabled
rows.description: Ignore pointer and keyboard input. moveTo still works.

rows.name: onDragStart / onDrag / onDragEnd / onJump
rows.description: Gesture callbacks, in unit. onDragEnd also fires after each keyboard move.

typeAliases.name: Position
typeAliases.description: A point in the chosen unit.

rows.name: x
rows.description: Horizontal: px offset, or 0..1 of the bounds box width.

rows.name: y
rows.description: Vertical: px offset, or 0..1 of the bounds box height.
